note: Phase 2 function replacement (tools/recomp/replace.py, tools/recomp/README.md 'Phase 2'). Each entry swaps one recompiled function for a body built from the named C source: mode ido (default) compiles it with the project's IDO (flags from the file's /* flags: */ header) into the .repl section N64Recomp recompiles; mode native compiles it for the host behind a generated o32 wrapper (leaf, word-sized memory through pointer arguments only). population: static | game | ovl_a | ovl_b. state: matched | draft | injected-bug | probe. mode capture (Phase 3) = a PROBE: the function is not replaced, its calls are only recorded (arguments from `prototype`) in both builds, so a replaced body's callees show where its behaviour first departs. A lane asks for a verdict by adding an entry and running tools/recomp/oracle.py (cloud/work/frontier/WAVE_BRIEF.md 'Behavioural check'). Replacing a function never changes coverage.
